UPSSSC Forest Guard/ Wild Life Guard Answer Key 2026 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the answer key for the recruitment of Forest Guard/ Wild Life Guard posts on the official website of UPSSSC. This recruitment was released for 708 posts. Applications for the UPSSSC Forest Guard/ Wild Life Guard Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 30 June 2026, to 22 July 2026. The examination was held on 27 September 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this examination can download their UPSSSC Forest Guard/ Wild Life Guard Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 30 June 2026
  • Last Date : 20 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 July 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 27 July 2026
  • Eligibility Result : 27 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 27 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 18 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 23 September 2026
  • Answer Key : 29 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 25/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
